Feeling unsure about starting solids?

If you haven’t started solids yet, you might be feeling:

Excited about baby-led weaning, but nervous about choking and potential allergens

Stressed because your pediatrician didn’t offer much guidance beyond handing them pouches and purées

Unsure what foods to start with or how to confidently serve them solids safely

That's exactly why 101 before one® exists — so you never have to piece
it together alone.

We’ll show you how to safely introduce real foods, help your baby learn to self-feed, and cook ONE family meal your baby can enjoy from just 6 months old.

In partnership with the American Academy of Pediatrics

Meet the pediatric experts behind 101 before one®

We are the only team of starting solids specialists published by the American Academy of Pediatrics on baby-led feeding, and we’ve helped more than 100,000 parents confidently introduce solids.

Our team brings together 20+ years of pediatric expertise in infant feeding, nutrition, and allergy. And just as importantly, we’re also moms. Between us, we’ve raised 12 children, so we understand how important it is to give your baby the best start with food.

Julie Laux, Founder

Founder & Starting Solids Specialist

Mom of 2 — Introduced 101 foods as a full-time working mom with her first daughter, and as a stay at home mom with her second.

Cinthia Scott, RD, IBCLC

Registered Dietitian & International Board Certified Lactation Consultant

Mom of 3 — Navigated a milk allergy (CMPA) with her second son and still completed 101 before one.

Dr. Krupa Playforth, MD

Board-Certified Pediatrician

Mom of 3 — Had to pivot for each of her kids because they all took to baby-led feeding differently. 

Dr. Manisha Relan, MD

Pediatric Allergist & Clinical Immunologist

Mom of 2 — Followed baby-led weaning as a vegan family (twice!) 

Catherine Callahan, MS, CCC-SLP, CLC

Pediatric Feeding Therapist and Certified Lactation Consultant

Mom of 3 — Loved teaching all her kids how to self-feed, but also how to communicate at mealtime with signs before they could talk (that’s the SLP in her).

From Starting Solids to Toddlerhood

The 101 before one® program is a complete system that guides you step-by-step so you can confidently introduce solid foods and serve real family meals.

  • Walk into your baby's first meal knowing exactly what to serve and what to expect.

    Our baby-led feeding Masterclass teaches you everything you need to know before starting solids, including what foods to serve, when to serve them, and how to serve them safely. You go into your baby’s first meal feeling knowledgeable about what to serve and what to expect. 

  • No separate baby meals. No extra cooking. Just one table, one meal, one family.

    Flexible, expert advice when you need it. Book hourly support across a range of topics—from planning to problem-solving. This focused consultation will help clarify your goals, map out next steps, and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Be prepared (and excited!) to feed your toddler with 101 After One.

    Most starting solids programs stop when your baby turns one. Ours continues into right toddlerhood with guidance, recipes, and meal plans so you can make a seamless transition from feeding your baby to feeding your toddler.

NO TEETH REQUIRED!

Feed your baby like family

When you follow 101 before one, your baby eats what you eat from day one. From Spaghetti & Meatballs to Chicken Curry to Taco night, we’re pushing the boundaries on what you call “baby food”.

The truth is, babies don’t need baby food at all - and let’s be serious, whatever's on your plate is way more exciting to them than a jar from the pantry. We’ll show you how to cook one meal that is safe for your 6 month old to eat (no teeth required!)

  • 1️⃣ 101 Before One was not created by just one expert in their field, we are a team of pediatric experts across a variety of fields.

    This means you have a program made by a pediatric allergist, feeding specialist, registered dietician, feeding therapist, and chef!

    So you get the best baby led weaning practices and meals from a well-rounded perspective.

    2️⃣ These are not recipes that only your baby can eat.

    These are family-style recipes with modifications and serving instructions for feeding your baby what you’re eating.

    You are feeding your family and your baby, together. Your baby will eat family meals with you from the start and eat what you do, not the other way around.

    3️⃣ You get access to weekly meal plans and shopping lists. Our families love our meal plans so much they continue using them after their children are toddlers and older.

    We give you and your baby nutritious meals during their first year and for the rest of your lives.

  • We recommend joining this program when your baby is between 4-6 months old.

    All research shows that starting solids at around 6 months is best. You’ll learn how to spot the signs that your baby is ready for solids in the program.

    With that being said, if your baby is 6 -10 months, you are not too late and we still recommend you join!

    You can start baby led weaning with 101 before one even if you’ve already tried introducing solids following another approach.

    You’ll get so much out of this program and set yourself up for feeding your toddler with success when you join when your baby is older. Most of our families use the recipes and meal plans they gain in 101 before one into toddlerhood and well beyond!

  • Every single meal and recipe has a full-color photo showing you exactly how to serve it to your baby. We know how important visuals are when you're learning to feed your baby safely.

  • Absolutely. All of our recipes are clearly marked to show if they are gluten free, egg free, soy free, dairy free, peanut free, etc.

    We also include substitutes and omissions for dietary needs in our recipes.

    Our recipes are searchable. Simply type in what you’re looking for, such as ‘gluten-free dinner recipes’ and you'll have a list of options right away.

    We also have a specific collection of vegan and plant-based recipes.

    We have families with a wide variety of diets and preferences who have loved 101 before one because this program makes it easy to feed their entire family and stay within their dietary guidelines.
